title: spec: a summary over a plain tenant-currency amount cannot say it is in the tenant currency — `currencyMode: 'dynamic'` is refused unless the child is a stored home amount
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

**Found by** hotcrm#2569, measured on 18.5.0 (zh-CN stack, tenant currency CNY); re-read on objectstack main.

## What happens
A `summary` (sum) over a child `Field.currency` in the default mode, which **is** the tenant currency, renders bare: `78,000.00` beside currency fields and currency formulas on the same record that render `¥120,000.00`. Declaring `currencyConfig: { currencyMode: 'dynamic' }` on it (e.g. `crm_timesheet.total_cost` over `crm_time_entry.cost_amount`) fails `objectstack validate`: "… 'crm_time_entry.cost_amount' is not a stored home amount, so its rows are not known to be in the home currency".

## Why (code)
`packages/spec/src/data/record-currency-path.ts:241` refuses `dynamic` unless the child field is named by a `homeAmount.field`; the `currencyConfig` description in `field.zod.ts` (~2447) admits otherwise only `fixed`, which needs a currency code and so pins one currency into a package meant for any tenant.

## Expected
A child currency field with no record/fixed currency is, by the field schema's own rule, in the tenant currency; a sum of it is too. Either admit `dynamic` over such a child, or render a summary over it with the tenant currency by default. hotcrm has 17 such summaries (PSA and O2C).
